Nov 3, 2026
88
Impulsegamer
Tom the Postgirl was a wonderful surprise, turning an ordinary delivery job into a bizarre adventure full of unexpected twists, strange characters, and dark humor. Its striking hand drawn visuals, fitting soundtrack, and abundance of secrets make exploring the village a real treat, especially when your curiosity leads to something completely unexpected. While its crude humor and disturbing moments may not appeal to everyone, I loved how willing the game was to embrace its weirdness. With its unpredictable story and memorable cast, Tom the Postgirl is a game that left me wanting more.
Nintendo Switch FULL REVIEW

Oct 29, 2026

GAMES.CH
If you are one of those people who love watching what your neighbors are doing through their illuminated windows during the dark fall and winter months then “Tom the Postgirl” just might be the game for you. It is extremely charming and looks gorgeous. The premise, story and even gameplay is very basic but still entertaining enough for its short playtime of roughly two hours. There is some replayability but even without it the game is entertaining enough for its short duration.
Nintendo Switch FULL REVIEW
